entities.summary: Veli-Matti Savinainen is a Finnish ice hockey player who plays for HC TPS in the Finnish Elite League]. A versatile player, Savinaien plays as a left winger and centre. Savinainen has won world championship gold in 2019 and silver in 2014, playing for Finland. He has also won six Finnish Championships, with HC Ässät in 2013 and with Tappara in 2016, 2017, 2022, 2023, and 2024. Savinainen also won the Champions Hockey League championship with Tappara in 2023, and represented Finland at the 2018 Winter Olympics.
